zoe: Heads-up: after yesterday's shadow routing tweak we saw a subtle SSE p99 bump in ap-southeast around 04:10. Not huge, but noisy enough to trigger the anomaly detector.
arpit: Shadow routing as in duplicate fanout to a candidate pool? Which rule changed?
zoe: We enabled 'shadow-path=fastpath' for a set of tenants to exercise new sticky routing heuristics. Shadow traffic should be instrumented but not billed.
morgan: Do we have traces? The sampling for shadowed SSE is at 0.2% so traces are sparse.
telemetry-bot: alert: sse.p99_delta > 40ms for tenant_group=beta (detected 04:11)
zoe: High-level diffs:
- route.shadow.enabled=true for ~120 tenants
- sse.p99 for those tenants increased from 240ms -> 290ms (5m rolling)
- route.swap.shadow_count reported ~6% additional swaps
arpit: Important: shadow traffic goes through the same route-selection logic, but we tag it with "shadow=true" so downstream should ignore it for quotas. Is the tag being propagated everywhere?
billing-svc: We flagged shadow traffic at ingress, but metering pipeline receives two events: one for the primary conn and one for shadow conn. Our filter removes events with tag=shadow for billing, but only if the tag is present in the metering proto. If the tag is missing (eg proxy didn't attach), we double-count.
zoe: Logs show some shadow flows missing the tag during partial failures. Example: 
```
[04:10:59] route: select tenant=beta id=pool-a -> pool-b shadow=true
[04:11:00] sse: conn_id=xyz attach_tags=["shadow"]
[04:11:01] path: transport-fanout error=write_timeout
[04:11:01] sse: conn_id=xyz2 attach_tags=[]
```
morgan: So fallback fanout path retried without tags. That would cause the metering pipeline to see an untagged connection for the same request.
arpit: We need two things: make shadow tagging robust (always-on at final egress) and make the console sampling smarter so we can debug these cases live.
console-team: Proposal: add a short-lived "shadow_debug_sampling" override to bump sampling to 5% for routes with shadow=true failures for 10m. Also surface a flag on dashboard to filter by tag.
telemetry-bot: note: we have a rollout guard that avoids increasing sampling by more than +4% globally to control ingest costs. The override needs to be scoped to route-id.
zoe: Config idea (WIP):
```
routing:
  shadow:
    enabled: true
    ensure_tagging_at: egress
    retry_preserve_tags: true
console:
  sampling_overrides:
    shadow_debug_pct: 5
    duration_minutes: 10
```
arpit: For retry_preserve_tags: ensure any retry paths copy the original request's attach_tags before re-enqueueing. Also add unit tests for path failures that assert tag preservation.
billing-svc: On our side we can add a safety net: if metering sees two near-identical connection events (same tenant, proxied_request_id, within 2s), drop the second event if it lacks shadow tag but the first had it. We'll need a small dedupe buffer and proto match keys.
morgan: We should avoid relying solely on dedupe heuristics; prefer fixing tag propagation first. But the dedupe is a good stopgap for today.
console-team: Also suggestion: emit a specialized metric 'sse.shadow_mismatch.count' when a shadowed request experiences an untagged retry so we can alert before billing shows up.
\o telemetery-bot: scheduled: bump shadow_debug_sampling to 5% for affected routes at 05:00; will auto-revert at 05:10.
zoe: Rollout plan for fix:
- patch routing layer: retry_preserve_tags true (small PR)
- add egress assertion to attach_tags always present (telemetry assertion + integration test)
- billing: dedupe guard for near-duplicate events (RFC + quick fix)
- console: sampling override + new metric and dashboard filter
morgan: Can we keep shadow traffic unbilled by default? Confirmed: billing-svc uses tag=shadow to skip ingestion. But if tag missing, current behavior is bill. After today's spikes billing team saw a minor overcount (rollback corrected most charges).
arpit: Action items:
- arpit: PR for retry_preserve_tags + tests (ETA 4h)
- morgan: add shadow_mismatch metric and dashboard widget (ETA 2h)
- billing-svc: implement dedupe rule (ETA 6h, low risk)
- console-team: add sampling override and filter (ETA 1h)
telemetry-bot: Canary note: schedule shadow fixes to staging deploy at 07:30.
zoe: Thanks 44d Let's watch for any p99 regressions after the egress tag fix. If we still see bump, consider adding a small routing cooldown window to avoid swapping on shadow probe differences.
arpit: Agreed. If needed we'll add 'shadow_cooldown_ms' to routing config.
morgan: One more note: ensure our SDKs and sidecars don't drop attach_tags on partial connection handoffs. Will add sanity checks in integration tests.
console-team: I'll create a short-lived alert: sse.shadow_mismatch.count > 0 -> page on-call (for first occurrence only).
zoe: Great. Re-evaluate after staging deploy.
